correctness.rationale: For a unit index modulo p, division with remainder and invertibility of p² modulo n reduce the gcd to gcd(n,t_r). At n=pm the gcd is m gcd(p,ap^(k−2)m^(k−1)), so the only exception to the zero value on multiples of p is (k,n)=(2,p). CRT lets a unit fiber realize H=1 immediately before a shift into a nonunit fiber if p does not divide the shift, and lets any prime in Q witness failure of a shift not divisible by that prime. After imposing pQ divisibility, a shift of p-adic order one would force equal prime supports on every lift of a given unit mod p (choose n divisible by exactly one prime of Q in a symmetric difference). For p not dividing k, the nonzero binomial slope runs through all representatives u+jp; u and u+p are coprime and the latter is greater than one. For p dividing k the slope vanishes so pQ suffices. All CRT witnesses recur at arbitrarily large n, including for p=2; if Q=1 the same argument applies without auxiliary primes. The isolated exception prevents starting at or before p and averaging each unit fiber by CRT gives the density; one partial period and one exceptional point give a uniform O(P) remainder. Both examples were checked independently against the floor-based predicate across two periods in /workspace/branches/reproduce_decisive.py; the frozen finite parameter sweep was inspected, not executed or used as a general proof.
